messages:
anya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — I'm moving the beta announcement post into final pass. Need legal signoff on the privacy claim and PM approval on the benchmark callouts. Target publish: tomorrow 10:00am PT. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example

sam (Product): Which benchmark lines are we calling out? Need the exact numbers + workload details so we don't overclaim.

anya (Marketing): Shortlist is in the doc under 'Benchmarks'. We call out p50 latency, p99 tail, and cost delta vs open-hosted baseline. Drew, can you confirm the p50/p99 numbers we used?

drew (Engineering): Confirmed — numbers come from the internal perf run on 2026-03-10. Quick snippet: ```p50: 72ms
p99: 350ms
workload: 512 tokens, batch=4
notes: A100x, quantized-run```

leo (Design): Updated hero image per brand refresh and attached a 1200x628 mock in the doc. Suggest shrinking the CTA slightly so the headline stays above the fold on mobile.

rachel (Legal): Quick flag — the line 'up to 10x cheaper' needs a citation or should be toned down. Also avoid 'bank-grade security' phrasing; 'enterprise-grade controls' is safer.

anya (Marketing): Good catch. I'll change to 'up to 7x lower inference cost vs baseline (see methodology)' and remove 'bank-grade'.

sam (Product): I can approve the benchmark framing provided Drew's numbers are linked to the methodology note and we call out the test setup.

rachel (Legal): Approve pending the methodology link + redaction of any customer-identifying data in the perf screenshots. Also please add a one-line customer consent mention if we include a user quote.

anya (Marketing): Done — added methodology section with a permalink and redacted the dashboard screenshot. Inserted the consent line under 'Customer quotes'.

leo (Design): Quick pass complete. One micro grammar nit in paragraph three — changed 'affect' -> 'effect' in the doc. Visuals look good.

drew (Engineering): Re-ran the perf export and attached verifiable CSV. All numbers match the snippet.

publish-bot: deploy-window-check: next available slot tomorrow 10:00am PT — no conflicts. Scheduling draft publish.

anya (Marketing): Perfect. If there are no objections by EOD I'll hit publish. :tada:

sam (Product): No objections from my side.

rachel (Legal): Approved.

drew (Engineering): Approved.

leo (Design): :thumbsup:

anya (Marketing): Publishing now. Thanks team!
